subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT a fundamental duty of an Indian citizen?

options.text: To value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture
To safeguard public property and to abjure violence
To uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity and integrity of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Voting in public elections is not listed as a fundamental duty of an Indian citizen.
 
• The fundamental duties of Indian citizens are laid out in Article 51A of the Constitution of India.
 
• These duties include respecting the Constitution, the national flag and the national anthem, cherishing the heritage of the country, protecting the sovereignty, unity and integrity of India, promoting harmony, and safeguarding public property, among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The concept of Fundamental Duties was added to the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976, upon the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee.
 
• Currently, there are 11 Fundamental Duties listed under Article 51A.
 
• These duties serve as a constant reminder to citizens that while enjoying their rights, they also have certain obligations towards the nation.
